prompt: Implement this REST endpoint in our Express app and wire it up to the existing controller, matching the OpenAPI contract we already have.

Define the API contract for the payments service — endpoints, versioning, and a deprecation plan for the old v1 routes.

Build the React component for the new pricing table using our existing design tokens.
Build an ETL pipeline that moves order events into our analytics warehouse nightly.
Design the RAG retrieval strategy — chunking, reranking, and the eval harness — for our support bot.

Decide which model tier each user request should go to, and set up a learned router that escalates to the strongest model on hard tasks.
